title: Persist client chat selection, drafts and unread state

status.capability: implemented, supported and default off; provider requires explicit host mounting
status.publication: prepared against brief/f-03; PR URL and exact-head CI recorded in the PR description

dependencies.reason: Owner-approved staged unmerged dependency stack. The concrete client consumes F-02/F-03 lifecycle and wire types. D-12 through D-15 own host composition and presentation.

design.scope: State and adapters only; no tab styling or visual affordance change

activation.client: BriefConversationProvider enabled prop defaults to false; no production entry mounts it in F-04
activation.readiness: Actual initialized conversation and transport services; all dependencies must also be enabled

acceptance.check: Ten add/close cycles preserve every surviving draft and history
acceptance.evidence: ui/src/brief/chat/client.test.ts: 30 conversations across ten cycles; right/left adjacency, inactive close, reopen and final blank state; all history retained

acceptance.check: Out-of-order events and delayed history never overwrite the selected conversation
acceptance.evidence: ui/src/brief/chat/store.test.ts and client.test.ts: sequence projection, snapshot watermark, ID-based history merge, stale async fences, serialized reconnect/selection and conversation-scoped errors

acceptance.check: Unsupported backend falls back to single chat
acceptance.evidence: ui/src/brief/chat/provider.test.tsx: actual existing history load and chat sender, no scoped frames; capability loss replaces the permanently opted-in socket

acceptance.check: One socket through room/theme changes and lifecycle cleanup
acceptance.evidence: ui/src/brief/chat/provider.test.tsx: StrictMode, ten room/theme remounts, manual retry, disconnect, capability loss, disabled mount, unmount and browser visibility

acceptance.check: Canonical server and local device state survive reconnect and reload
acceptance.evidence: ui/src/brief/chat/integration.test.ts: actual HTTP routes/WebSocket transport, isolated SQLite, separate histories and exactly two fake-model executions; store.test.ts covers local storage and workspace isolation

verification.browser_bundle: passed: bun build ui/src/brief/chat/provider.tsx --target=browser; 14 modules, no server runtime dependencies
verification.guards: Normal commit hook result recorded in the PR description
verification.full_suite: Not run locally; exact-head remote CI is reported separately

manual_checks.main_and_open_prs: Fetched and checked before editing; D/Q feature work is on separate branches. F-03's corrected Tests/Docker checks pass.
manual_checks.browser_automation: not_run: React lifecycle uses happy-dom and counted WebSocket fakes; protocol integration uses real local HTTP/WebSocket
manual_checks.external_effects: none: deterministic model fixtures only, no user database or running daemon

limitations: Production host mounting and tab presentation remain D-12 through D-15 work.
Composer state is device-local, not cross-device; canonical messages and selection stay on the server.
Attachment references are retained, but file upload/validation/turn binding remains F-05; sending with refs rejects explicitly.
Scoped text sends use speak=false; scoped voice playback is not activated.
A failed two-step close can leave the neighbor selected while the original tab remains open; state is reconciled and the error is visible.
No live browser design review or hosted provider quality claim is made.
rollback: Disable chatState activation and keep the existing dashboard entry. Retain local draft keys and server conversations. Do not delete messages, drop tables or replay work.
